Classic ominous La Rata BLACK AND EMERALD GREEN palette with restrained material accents, substantial dark quiet areas. A sacrificed royal CROWN is the lightning conductor on a cracked black stone offering altar in a drowned gothic vault. The crown is a large heavy black-iron circlet with three broad tarnished copper points, tilted diagonally toward the viewer. A brilliant EMERALD electrical strike hits its highest point, and a controlled branching arc leaps outward into three separate hovering round energy ORBS, visibly waking them. Dynamic low viewpoint; crown and first orb dominate the foreground, the others recede in a curved diagonal into deep dark space. No rat, person, hands, bell, scepter, skull, mechanical wires, floating playing cards or coins. Keep the orbs spherical, the crown physically grounded and the lightning clean rather than a tangled net.
